scope: Controlled private preview on the existing Rakuen test infrastructure; not public redistribution or arbitrary model/container support

binary_review.consumer_library: Extracted from the exact r13 image; ABI/export/debug/private-marker audit passed
binary_review.client_package: Explicit allowlist: compiled consumer, signed runtime/profile metadata, model/tokenizer files and notices; no hosted compiler, source exporter, source database credential, client enrollment credential or signing key
binary_review.runtime: Unmodified pinned vLLM with the private supported extension; no monkeypatch entrypoint or fork
binary_review.limitations: Compiled code can still be reverse engineered; no secrecy guarantee is claimed

dependency_review.rust_license_families: MIT, Apache-2.0 (including LLVM exception), BSD, ISC, Zlib, Unicode-3.0, BSL-1.0 and CDLA-Permissive-2.0; bundled notices retained
dependency_review.model_notice: Gemma 4 Apache-2.0 license and Q8_0 conversion notice retained
dependency_review.python_and_os: Exact inventories and matched-image remediation retained under native-production-20260926; third-party container notices remain in the image
dependency_review.security_scope: Loopback text API, signed local model files, no remote model code, no user-supplied Python/class/checkpoint execution
known_limitations: Pinned Torch still crashes on the isolated TorchScript class reproducer; this is outside the certified text-serving interface, not a patched vulnerability
Setuptools 79.0.1 remains pinned for upstream compatibility; private package builds use an explicit ASCII file list and do not publish an sdist
Installed flash-attention training advisory modules are absent; a separate torch.load call exists outside the certified loader
OS scan retains 207 medium/low non-header entries and 3865 kernel-header entries; no available Ubuntu fix and no non-header high/critical entry remained in r13
External redistribution requires its own complete review of container source/notice obligations; this record does not approve a public release

performance_review.new_ordered_working_set: Private CPU model preparation may take tens of seconds; the observed first fallback request took 42.617 seconds including preparation and generation. Repeated request took 1.888 seconds including generation.
performance_review.claim_boundary: Preparation, activation, attention and end-to-end inference are different measurements. No universal speedup or microsecond cold-path claim. Source order is retained in the preparation identity.

decision: Reviewed for controlled private-preview installation and lifecycle validation with the stated limits; not a public-production security or redistribution clearance
